verdict.rationale: Anthropic Skills is a skill format, open standard, and repository rather than an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a plausible capability and the axis applies. The evidence does not show one. MCP mentions are client-side: Claude Code connects to MCP servers, plugins can bundle third-party MCP servers, and the Agent SDK offers an in-process MCP server for your own custom tools. None of these is an official MCP server that serves Skills to other agents.
